name: Fire29 readable distributed flames
description: KEEP the new scattered positions across the surface. But the latest tongues became dark brown mounds and nearly invisible at half size, losing the user's accepted clear motion. Make them visibly LUMINOUS FIRE with rounded painted bodies, not rocks. Restore the orange glowing appearance from the earlier layered version at these new positions: saturated red-orange translucent outer body, bright orange middle, small warm pale-orange/yellow inner core. Useful palette outer#d73604, middle#ff840c, core#ffd45d; core occupies about20percent, no solid flat two-color triangles. Soft textured gradients and small layered curls give volume. Do not desaturate or lower opacity until the flames merge with the floor. Preserve actual growth excursion: each short tongue tip moves from6px to22px above its fixed base, smoothly redrawn as it grows/recedes; rooted bottom third stays still. At game scale that is8px noticeable contour movement. Broad bases26-34px, irregular short tips, no tall thin jets. Existing six scattered groups, mostly interior, only two rim overlaps; no edge row or apex-only torch. Asynchronous phases, steady color/intensity, only shapes change. Source floor/texture flow and camera fixed.32frames20fps seamless. No flashing, opacity pulses, sparks, smoke or whole-shape bending. Prioritize readable warm burning tongues over dark subtle bumps.
